notes: Split suspense now flows into the P&L (VCA319): when a split corrects a mis-entered auction price or quantity, that suspense (Dr raises, Cr lowers) is folded into the day's spread so the margin is right; the Spread drill shows the adjustment. View/Edit Splits gains a 'with adjustment only' filter and a 'Sus' badge next to invoices that carry a split suspense. Dotted column separators added to the Splits, Loan Transactions, Sellers, Buyers, Locations and Buyer-Betel tables (VCA320).
